topic: A data table needs to distinguish missing from zero
grammarFocus: 学术论证的限定、因果、对比与证据范围
title: A data table needs to distinguish missing from zero
instructions: 原创学术微训练；场景、机构与数值均为虚构模拟，不是事实报道或官方试题。先独立盲听答题，再用原句核对限定、比较与因果。短篇专项不能替代完整陌生测评。
transcript:
Tutor: Your table contains several zeros. Do they all mean the same thing?
Iris: I used zero when a shop reported no customers, and also when the form was not returned.
Tutor: Those are different. One is an observed count; the other is missing information.
Iris: I will label the unreturned forms as missing and recalculate the average using the available observations. But I should not imply that those observations represent every shop equally well.
Tutor: Exactly. How many forms are missing?
Iris: Seven out of thirty. Four came from the eastern district, where some shops closed early during roadworks.
Tutor: Could that pattern matter?
Iris: Yes. Non-response may be related to trading conditions. It is not necessarily random, so deleting the missing rows could leave a misleading picture.
Tutor: Will you invent values to complete the table?
Iris: No. I can show a sensitivity check: what happens to the overall result under clearly stated low and high assumptions for the missing shops. Those are scenarios, not recovered observations.
Tutor: What will the headline say?
Iris: Average customer count among responding shops, with the response total beside it. I will also describe the concentration of missing forms in the east. The limitation belongs with the result, not hidden at the end.

questions.prompt: What two situations had Iris initially coded alike?
options: No customers and no returned form.
Two different shop opening times only.
A high and a low price for the same product.
Every observed customer count and its date.
answers: No customers and no returned form.
questions.explanation: 依据原文“when a shop reported no customers, and also when the form was not returned.”。正确项保持了原文的范围和关系，其余项改动了该信息。
questions.evidence: when a shop reported no customers, and also when the form was not returned.

questions.explanation: 依据原文“Seven out of thirty.”。答案按原文填写，保留限定范围。 数量允许本题列出的等值数字写法；单位接受明确列出的英美拼写。

questions.prompt: In which district were four missing forms concentrated?
questions.explanation: 依据原文“Four came from the eastern district”。答案按原文填写，保留限定范围。
questions.evidence: Four came from the eastern district

questions.prompt: Why may the pattern of missingness matter?
options: It makes all returned forms false.
It could be related to local trading conditions.
It proves every unreported shop had no customers.
It guarantees a perfectly random sample.
answers: It could be related to local trading conditions.
questions.explanation: 依据原文“Non-response may be related to trading conditions.”。正确项保持了原文的范围和关系，其余项改动了该信息。
questions.evidence: Non-response may be related to trading conditions.

questions.prompt: What will be recalculated using available observations?
questions.explanation: 依据原文“recalculate the average using the available observations.”。答案按原文填写，保留限定范围。
questions.evidence: recalculate the average using the available observations.

questions.prompt: What is the proposed sensitivity check based on?
options: Secretly replacing every gap with zero.
Recovering exact values without new evidence.
Removing the eastern district from the report title.
Clearly labelled assumptions about the missing shops.
answers: Clearly labelled assumptions about the missing shops.
questions.explanation: 依据原文“clearly stated low and high assumptions for the missing shops.”。正确项保持了原文的范围和关系，其余项改动了该信息。
questions.evidence: clearly stated low and high assumptions for the missing shops.

questions.prompt: What must the scenarios not be presented as?
questions.explanation: 依据原文“not recovered observations.”。答案按原文填写，保留限定范围。

questions.prompt: Who will the headline average explicitly describe?
options: Every shop in every district equally.
Responding shops.
All shops with complete certainty.
Only shops confirmed to have no customers.
questions.explanation: 依据原文“among responding shops”。正确项保持了原文的范围和关系，其余项改动了该信息。
